name: RomMArcade
description: Open a game in RomMArcade: it installs the game through EmuDeck if needed, then plays it.
author: jkoehler11

settings.label: Offer RomMArcade when you press Play
settings.help: Off hides the Play entry; RomM's own Play stays as it was.

settings.label: Hand-over parameters
settings.help: Appended to the rommarcade:// link. play=1 installs the game first and then starts it; clear this to only open the game.

settings.label: RomMArcade's web address
settings.help: The address the RomMArcade entry in Settings navigation opens, for a machine where the rommarcade:// handler is not registered.
